title: 第5章 师叔祖听着太老了第6章 这位师姐到底是什么怪物啊
slug: 满级师妹她缺德但能打
content_zh:
整个丹房死寂一片！
所有弟子都石化了，张大了嘴巴，看着那九颗仿佛不该存在于世的丹药。
林风啸脸色煞白，身体微微颤抖，道心受到了前所未有的冲击。
她…她真的做到了？！
凭感觉？！
“成了。”
云杳杳拍了拍手，松了口气，小声嘀咕，“看来化学反应原理在修真界也通用嘛…就是能量形式不一样。”
古长老猛地转头，死死盯着云杳杳，声音嘶哑：“你…你究竟是如何做到的？！
这手法…这时机…”
云杳杳挠挠头：“就…感觉那样做是对的，就试了试。
看来感觉没错。”
她没法解释蓝星的逻辑，只能归咎于玄乎的“感觉”
古长老：“……”
他感觉自己几百年的丹道修为都修到狗身上去了！
多少丹师穷尽一生都无法触摸极品丹的门槛，她凭“感觉”
一次就成功了？！
还他妈是满丹？！
“这…这不可能！
定是巧合！”
古长老不愿相信，他从旁边拿起另一份材料，“你再炼一次！

就用你刚才的方法！”
云杳杳无所谓地耸耸肩，再次开炉。
同样的行云流水，同样的精准控制，同样的时机把握。
片刻后，炉开。
又是九颗宝光流转、丹纹隐现的极品聚气丹！
古长老：“！
！”
他不信邪，又让云杳杳炼了第三次、第四次…
结果毫无例外，每一次，都是满丹九颗极品无暇！
整个丹房鸦雀无声，只剩下丹炉余热的轻微嗡鸣和众人粗重的呼吸声。
古长老仿佛一瞬间苍老了十岁，他看着云杳杳，眼神复杂到了极点，有震惊，有难以置信，有狂喜，更有一种深深的无力感。
他颤抖着拿起一颗极品聚气丹，喃喃道：“极品…真的是极品无暇…万载难题…竟…竟如此…”
他猛地看向云杳杳，眼神炽热得像要燃烧起来：“云师侄…不！
云师妹！
你这手法…可能外传？可能教授？！”
云杳杳被他的眼神吓了一跳，后退半步，为难道：“这个…我真不知道该怎么教…就是感觉到了就那么做了…”
她说的是实话，这涉及到她潜意识里蓝星的逻辑思维和对能量物质的独特理解，根本无法用修真界的理论体系来解释和传授。
古长老眼中的炽热慢慢熄灭，化为一声长叹。
他明白了，这或许是一种独一无二的天赋，一种无法复制的奇迹。
他颓然道：“是老夫痴心妄想了…此乃天授，非人力可强求。”

他小心翼翼地将那几炉极品聚气丹收好，视若珍宝，然后对云杳杳郑重一礼：“云师妹丹道天赋，旷古烁今！
老夫…受教了！”
content_en:
The entire alchemy room was completely silent!
All the disciples were petrified, with their mouths wide open, looking at the nine pills that seemed like they should not exist in the world.
Lin Fengxiao's face turned pale, his body trembled slightly, and his Taoist heart was hit like never before.
She...she really did it? !
By feeling? !
"It's done."
Yun Yaoyao clapped his hands, breathed a sigh of relief, and murmured in a low voice, "It seems that the principles of chemical reactions are also common in the world of cultivation...it's just that the energy form is different."
Elder Gu suddenly turned his head and stared at Yun Yaoyao with a hoarse voice: "You... how on earth did you do that?!
This technique...this timing..."
Yun Yaoyao scratched his head: "I just... felt that it was right to do that, so I gave it a try.
It seems to feel right. "
She couldn't explain Blue Star's logic and could only blame it on the mysterious "feeling"
Elder Gu: "..."
He felt that all his hundreds of years of alchemy cultivation had been transferred to the dog!
How many alchemists have spent their whole lives unable to touch the threshold of the best elixirs, she relies on "feeling"
Success the first time? !
Is it fucking Mandan? !
"This...this is impossible!
It must be a coincidence! "
Elder Gu didn't want to believe it, so he picked up another material from the side and said, "Practice again!
Just use the method you just did! "
Yun Yaoyao shrugged indifferently and turned on the stove again.
The same smooth flow, the same precise control, the same timing.
After a while, the furnace turned on.
Another top quality Qi Gathering Pill with nine precious lights flowing around and the pill pattern looming!
Elder Gu: “!
! "
He didn't believe in evil, so he asked Yun Yaoyao to practice it a third and fourth time...
The result is without exception, every time, the nine full elixirs are of the highest quality!
The entire alchemy room was silent, except for the slight hum of the residual heat of the alchemy furnace and the heavy breathing of everyone.
Elder Gu seemed to have aged ten years in an instant. He looked at Yun Yaoyao with extremely complicated eyes, ranging from shock to disbelief to ecstasy and a deep sense of powerlessness.
He tremblingly picked up a top-grade Qi Gathering Pill and murmured: "The top-grade... It's really the top-grade flawless... It's been a problem for ten thousand years... It's actually... it's like this..."
He suddenly looked at Yun Yaoyao, his eyes so hot that they seemed to be burning: "Master Yun... no!
Junior Sister Yun!
This technique of yours...could it be spread to outsiders? Maybe a professor? ! "
Yun Yaoyao was startled by his eyes and took half a step back, wondering: "This... I really don't know how to teach... I just did it when I felt it..."
She was telling the truth, which involved Blue Star's logical thinking and unique understanding of energy and matter in her subconscious, which could not be explained and taught by the theoretical system of the cultivation world.
The heat in the ancient elder's eyes slowly extinguished and turned into a long sigh.
He understood that this might be a unique talent, a miracle that could not be replicated.
He said dejectedly: "I am just wishful thinking... This is a gift from heaven and cannot be forced by man."
He carefully put away the furnaces of the best Qi Gathering Pills, treating them as treasures, and then saluted Yun Yaoyao solemnly: "Junior Sister Yun's talent in the way of alchemy is as outstanding as ever!
I've learned a lesson... "
